description: The single machine-readable source of truth for every GitHub label gaia-react/gaia creates, syncs, and documents. The `gaia labels` CLI reads this file: `sync` decides what to create, rename, or report on a target repository; `docs` renders it into wiki/concepts/GitHub Labels.md; `check` cross-references it against every label literal in the tree. Palette rule: warm colors (red, orange, amber) are reserved for attention, urgency, defect type, human-required gates, and the active-work claim; every other classificatory axis takes a cool or neutral family instead, and every hex value is lowercase.

labels.name: bug

labels.name: difficulty:hard

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: GitHub default; deliberately absent from GAIA
labels.reason: Solicits drive-by contributions from people with no context for the work. GitHub recreates it on every new repository, so it needs an explicit block rather than a one-time delete.

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: GitHub default; deliberately absent from GAIA
labels.reason: Same solicitation problem as good first issue. Both are GitHub defaults, recreated on every new repository, so a one-time delete does not hold.
